sources.title: README.md
sources.locator: Intro; Features; Installation; How it works; What Ordewell sends; License
sources.finding: Planner turns a goal into an editable plan run across eight coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot CLI, Qwen Code, Cline, Gemini CLI, Cursor); terminal UI, VS Code extension, CLI, local API; install via curl script (macOS/Linux), Homebrew, npm (Windows); worktree isolation; daily version check with opt-out; Apache-2.0.

sources.title: LICENSE
sources.finding: Apache License, Version 2.0 for the whole repository; name and logos excluded (NOTICE).

sources.title: SECURITY.md
sources.locator: Supported versions; What is in scope; What each part can touch
sources.finding: Pre-1.0, only latest supported; planner exploration envelope with OS sandbox on Linux (bubblewrap) and macOS (Seatbelt); runners run as the user without OS sandbox; private advisory reporting with 3-day acknowledgement target.

sources.title: CHANGELOG.md
sources.finding: Release notes for 0.13.3: desktop macOS install confirmation, ordewell merge, ordewell decisions, decision record in desktop.

sources.title: packages/cli/src/help.ts
sources.locator: printHelp command list and ORDEWELL_* environment
sources.finding: CLI commands for plan, run, approve, stop, status, sessions, fork, compact, rewind, merge, per-task runner/model/effort/mode/deps/skills, checkpoint, retry, cancel; env vars for approval allowlist, notify command, daemon port, max parallel (default 5).

sources.title: packages/cli/src/runnerNames.ts
sources.finding: Runner and planner id lists are read from RunnerRegistry rather than hard-coded.

sources.title: packages/web/README.md
sources.finding: Local Hono HTTP+WebSocket daemon on 127.0.0.1:3742 with routes /api/sessions, plans, runners, models, settings, workspaces, approvals, escalations; bearer token minted at startup; no frontend; browser UI may come later.

sources.title: packages/vscode/README.md
sources.finding: VS Code extension with editable plan, per-task model/effort, worktree isolation, skills, script tasks, check-and-fix loops, research tasks, plan-limit and cost footers, harness planners.

sources.title: docs/planners-and-runners.md
sources.finding: Harness planners use the coding agent's own login; API planners use OpenRouter, Gemini, DeepSeek, Moonshot/Kimi, xAI keys; runners are coding-agent CLIs; Qwen Code and Cline use keys held by Ordewell.

sources.title: docs/containers.md
sources.finding: Container mode is experimental and off in published versions; the containers setting is ignored in a release.

sources.title: docs/desktop/README.md
sources.finding: Desktop app is not in a release yet: releases do not carry installers; run from source.

sources.title: docs/skills.md
sources.finding: Repository skills the planner attaches to tasks across runners.

sources.title: docs/adr/isolation/0013-worktree-isolation.md
sources.finding: One checkout per task and one branch per run when the workspace is a git repo group; user opts into merge; no remote operation.

sources.title: docs/adr/runners/0022-ordewell-mcp-server.md
sources.finding: One MCP server with per-caller tokens: runners complete tasks and ask checkpoints through it; coding-agent planners read the catalog and submit plans through it.

sources.title: docs/adr/supervision/0029-the-supervisor.md
sources.finding: Supervisor level Off, Watch or Act; Act can run, stop, retry, skip, message runners, deny approvals, edit the plan and merge within loop guards.

sources.title: docs/adr/supervision/0030-global-run-settings.md
sources.finding: Autorun, supervisor level, merge at gates, parallel limit are global run settings.

sources.title: docs/adr/supervision/0034-a-failed-task-blocks-only-its-dependents.md
sources.finding: A failed task blocks only its transitive dependents; independent work keeps starting.

sources.title: docs/adr/supervision/0035-effects-are-consented-and-recorded.md
sources.finding: Effects such as pushes need consent and are recorded.

sources.title: docs/adr/supervision/0037-research-tasks-wake-the-planner.md
sources.finding: Research tasks report back to the planner that started them.

sources.title: docs/adr/supervision/0045-a-check-repeats-with-its-fix-until-it-passes.md
sources.finding: Check-and-fix loops repeat until the check passes or the round limit.

sources.title: docs/adr/isolation/0049-a-session-has-one-live-host.md
sources.finding: Session lease: one live host per session; two hosts once ran one session.

sources.title: docs/adr/supervision/0053-what-waits-on-a-person-is-derived-and-answered-in-one-call.md
sources.finding: What waits on a person (approvals, checkpoints, conflicts, failures) is derived once and answered through one call; listed at /escalations.

sources.title: docs/adr/supervision/0055-a-delegated-task-is-a-child-plan-behind-the-runner-seam.md
sources.finding: Delegated child plans partially implemented; delegation held out by ORDEWELL_DELEGATION=1.

sources.title: docs/adr/isolation/0062-user-git-actions-are-confirmed-at-a-host-and-a-live-run-holds-only-its-landing-branch.md
sources.finding: Host git actions: commit, branch, stash, fetch, pull, push to tracking remote for the user; arbitrary merge, rebase and pull requests are later.

sources.title: docs/adr/surfaces/0063-the-desktop-app-is-an-electron-client-of-the-shared-daemon.md
sources.finding: Desktop app is an Electron client of the shared local daemon.

sources.title: packages/core/src/services/VersionCheck.ts
sources.finding: Daily version check can be turned off by ORDEWELL_NO_VERSION_CHECK=1 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1.

sources.title: .github/workflows/release.yml
sources.finding: Release builds CLI archives for darwin and linux (arm64, x64), install.sh and SHA256SUMS; desktop is built only when ORDEWELL_RELEASE_DESKTOP is true.

sources.title: packages/core/src/services/AccountLimitMonitor.ts
sources.finding: Reads Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode Go plan-limit windows for display and pauses.

sources.title: packages/core/src/services/SlotPool.ts
sources.finding: Parallel limit across a plan tree.

sources.title: packages/core/src/services
sources.locator: bounded search at v0.13.3 of packages/ and docs/: saml, oidc, scim, rbac, single sign, cron, webhook, scheduled run, gh pr create, spend limit, max-budget, rollback
sources.finding: Bounded search found no SSO/SAML/OIDC/SCIM or role model, no scheduler or webhook trigger, no pull-request creation and no spend-limit flag; hits were unrelated words or ADR text.

sources.title: GitHub repository metadata
sources.finding: 210 stars, Apache-2.0, pushed 2026-11-17, homepage ordewell.ai; latest release v0.13.3 (2026-11-15) with CLI archives only.

sources.title: Ordewell home page
sources.locator: Ordewell home page|hero and how it works
sources.finding: Apache 2.0, eight supported coding agents, macOS and Linux one binary, Windows via npm, no API key if a coding agent is signed in, nothing runs until approved; no pricing page.
